title: Rename or rewrite the crash_reported test in epic_27_story_14_analytics_test.dart to match its assertion
why: The test name says the null crashlytics service does NOT fire the event; the body never constructs NullCrashlyticsService at all and instead calls `analytics.logCrashReported` directly, asserting the event DOES fire (count==1) — the opposite claim of the name. NullCrashlyticsService's real no-op behaviour is separately and correctly covered by test/core/logging/crashlytics_service_test.dart, so there's no coverage gap, but a reader trusting this acceptance test's name would draw the wrong conclusion about what it demonstrates.
recommendation: Rename to describe what's actually asserted (e.g. 'logCrashReported records exactly one crash_reported event'), or rewrite the body to construct NullCrashlyticsService with a spy AnalyticsService and assert it's never called.
acceptance_criteria: Test name matches its assertion's actual subject and polarity.
